claims: Planning session for "Anchor — Honest Telemetry + Warm Resume" produced a Foreman-ready Implementation Plan (approved doc-trio under planning/telemetry-resume-2026-07/handoff/approved/).

North Star: every Anchor session — interactive ConPTY or one-shot job — leaves an honest, machine-verified cost trail (tokens/time/$) so rollup numbers mean "measured truth, not zero-by-omission," and clicking any session tile opens a warm terminal narrating what was done, produced, and next.

The plan defines 7 success criteria, including: real usage capture via the engine's session JSONL sidecar with finalize on every end path; an honesty contract (discovered/imported efforts contribute exactly 0, an explicit "unmeasured" state distinct from $0.00, no cost ever estimated or fabricated); dedup so persisted docs + a RUN cost record never double-count; and the diag-B2 tile bugs reproduced first, then fixed.

Wave 1 (Ground Truth) freezes design inputs before build: pin real Claude sidecar fixtures from a 3-turn PTY run, audit the closed-world v4-rollup/v8-persist suites, record narration-floor cost arithmetic, verify plan-mode enforceability for orientation, capture registry-state fixtures, reproduce the three diag-B2 tile bugs in Playwright (blank window, context-free blue restart, manual orientation), and commit a North Star amendment carrying every locked contract verbatim (including the Gemini-segment stub RULED as Option C).

Wave 2 (Durability Substrate) lands atomic temp-file+rename writes for finalize-touched files, a cost_final compare-and-set keyed by session_id, a 50x concurrent kill/close/reconcile race test asserting exactly one finalized cost record, and a fail-closed sidecar-root resolver so tests/healthcheck can never open the live ~/.claude store.

Wave 3 (Narration Floor) makes any tile narrate with zero PTY and zero synchronous model calls: a deterministic template over registry facts + doc-roles, lazy enrichment via the existing background summary path with a "summary generating…" badge, a Layer-1 warm view in the session-window terminal chrome rendering in <200ms, and a token-authed narration GET route pinned by an auth-enumeration test.

Wave 4 (Usage-Capture Pipeline) captures the engine session UUID at launch (never mtime-guessed), sums per-message usage against the pinned fixture with explicit measured/partial/unmeasured(reason) states, keeps an append-only idempotent ledger, eagerly finalizes on every end path (kill, close/park, drain, finish, reconcile-dead) into .anchor/, routes one-shot job usage through the same ledger, and writes an atomic state='capture-failed' record (never measured-$0) when a sidecar is present but unparseable.

Wave 5 (Rollup Honesty) pins rollup dedup by test, renders three visually distinct states (measured / unmeasured with enum reason / capture-failed red-tinted), shows dollars only when the engine reported them ("N tok · Xm (subscription)" on the Max host), stamps a capture-rate line on the dashboard, and renders mixed Claude+Gemini sessions as "partial (gemini segment unmeasured)" per RULED Option C.

Wave 7 (Verification & Deploy) adds a fully stubbed healthcheck capture+finalize walk with a RED corrupted-fixture leg, a split-severity drift tripwire (zero sidecars → warn; present-but-unparseable → deterministic RED), one live smoke run where the rollup delta must match the sidecar's reported usage exactly on tokens, a one-week ≥90% capture-rate follow-up, the measured before/after undercount recorded in the execution log, and a dated Option-C Gemini-telemetry fast-follow entry.

Constraints locked throughout: Python stdlib-only (pywinpty exception) passing distro.py's import scan; tests never touch the live :8777 service (stub PTY + ANCHOR_RUNNER_CMD + fake sidecar fixtures); resume/advance tests follow the v11/v11.1 worktree-only lessons; test command is `python -m pytest tests/ -v`.

This is a planning-lane session for the "Anchor — Honest Telemetry + Warm Resume" effort; its member document is the Foreman-ready Implementation Plan (the Stage-2 Crucible artifact), and the session title marks the plan as approved.
Wave 1 ("Ground Truth") is a freeze-the-design-inputs wave: its intent is to pin every design input before any build work starts.

Wave 1's scoped work includes: a sidecar spike pinning the real observed Claude sidecar shape as canonical fixtures under `tests/fixtures/sidecar/` (captured from a real 3-turn interactive claude run); an audit of the closed-world test suites; recording the narration-floor cost arithmetic; verifying plan-mode enforceability for orientation; capturing real registry-state fixtures; and reproducing the diag-B2 tile bugs.
Wave 1 also delivers a North Star doc amendment that carries every locked contract verbatim, including the Gemini-segment stub ruled as Option C at approval time.
Per the plan text, Wave 1 serves acceptance criteria (1), (4), (5), and (6).
No build/execution work is claimed by this session — the documents present are planning artifacts only (an implementation plan handed off Foreman-ready).
